errors.text_span: 并通过图例与右侧的饼图相关联，表明右侧的饼图是左侧黄色扇区的细分
errors.evidence: The relationship between the two pie charts (the right chart being a breakdown of the yellow slice of the left chart) is indicated by two gray connecting lines, not by the legend at the bottom of the figure.
The label for the green slice in the right pie chart is "‘的’字只现不隐". The machine-generated description omits the character '只'.

The description does not mention the content of the legend at the bottom of the chart, which uses numeric codes (1=blue, 2=orange, 3=green) for color identification, even though it implies the legend's existence.
